title: Einstein letter to FDR leads to the Manhattan Project
summary: Robert Salas tells of Einstein letter to FDR leads to the Manhattan Project, about 1939-1945 at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: it was brought to the attention by Einstein and and another fellow whose name I can't remember right now, but they wrote to FDR for a meeting about the possibility that Germany could build an atomic bomb.

plain: Robert Salas, a former US Air Force officer, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that Albert Einstein and another man whose name Salas could not recall wrote to President Franklin D. Roosevelt warning that Germany might build an atomic bomb. Salas says this led to the Manhattan Project, the American wartime effort from 1939 to 1945 to build the bomb first. He gives it as background to the nuclear history behind his own story.
